an4.100:3.1: Worthy Gotama, these four individuals are found in the world.
an4.100:3.3: Worthy Gotama, one individual criticizes those deserving of criticism at the right time, truthfully and correctly. But they don’t praise those deserving of praise at the right time, truthfully and correctly.
an4.100:3.4: Worthy Gotama, another individual praises those deserving of praise … But they don’t criticize those deserving of criticism …
an4.100:3.5: Worthy Gotama, another individual doesn’t praise those deserving of praise … Nor do they criticize those deserving of criticism …
an4.100:3.6: Worthy Gotama, another individual criticizes those deserving of criticism at the right time, truthfully and correctly, and praises those deserving of praise at the right time, truthfully and correctly.
an4.100:3.7: Worthy Gotama, these are the four individuals found in the world.
an4.100:4.1: Potaliya, these four individuals are found in the world.
an4.100:4.2: What four? … Potaliya, these are the four individuals found in the world.
